measurement: Bath and tissue extracellular pH of the WWOX preparation (slice or culture), measured at the recording site and time with the same aCSF, gas mix and temperature used for the pharmacology, in wild type and Wwox-deleted tissue, with a stated method and calibration
why_no_literature_can_substitute: No source reports the pH of this preparation; pH of a bath is not the pH of tissue, and no pathological pH is assumed; the answer decides whether NP10679 is a probe of a condition or just another NAM

measurement: Bath Mg2+ and K+ and a Zn2+ chelator arm (measured, not nominal) in the same recordings
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The NAM-removable share depends on tonic Zn2+ for ifenprodil (24607230; prop D03 of the earlier nmda_composition package) and Mg2+/state for every NAM; the onfasprodil patent assay had neither Mg2+ nor a stated chelator; no literature gives them for this preparation

measurement: Maximum inhibition (not only IC50) of NP10679 at two measured pH values (the bath pH of the preparation and a physiological reference) on recombinant GluN1/GluN2B, with glutamate, glycine, Zn2+ chelator, holding potential, Mg2+ and temperature written down
why_no_literature_can_substitute: An IC50 pair exists at abstract level (21 nM at pH 6.9, 130 nM at pH 7.6, ACNP 2017 W168, same origin as the registry value), but no maximum at either pH and no recording conditions are in any file; the discovery paper (34493631) could not be opened

measurement: Maximum inhibition of onfasprodil and of NP10679 on GluN1/GluN2B diheteromers and on GluN1/GluN2A/GluN2B triheteromers in one expression system, with ifenprodil run alongside as the reference
why_no_literature_can_substitute: No source reached tests either compound on triheteromers; ifenprodil's 88 and 32 percent cannot be assigned to another compound, and radiprodil showed the maximum depends on assembly

measurement: Site test for onfasprodil (non-additivity with a saturating ifenprodil-site ligand, or a GluN1/GluN2B amino-terminal-domain mutation known to remove ifenprodil action) and the same for NP10679
why_no_literature_can_substitute: Only a docking and mutagenesis result for the series prototype exists; neither compound has a stated site in anything opened; without it no equivalence or independence from the ifenprodil site can be claimed

measurement: Subunit selectivity of onfasprodil on GluN2A, GluN2C and GluN2D (and a small off-target panel including H1 for context) under the same conditions as M04
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The patent assay uses one construct and GtoPdb records selectivity as not determined

measurement: In the slice arm: vehicle time control and a measurement of the percent of isolated NMDAR current removed by each NAM, with d-APV as the reference, before any behavioural or network readout
why_no_literature_can_substitute: No native-tissue datum exists for NP10679 and none for onfasprodil; the S3 design depends on this share
